cases.title: Address open face with grip and lead-wrist feedback
cases.coaching_finding: Coach judges top face open with cupped wrist in current grip context.
cases.coach_reasoning: He expects grip plus wrist feedback to bring face nearer lead-arm alignment and reduce difficult late compensation.

intervention.action: Use grip and wrist feedback to explore flatter lead wrist and more neutral face.
intervention.source_aids: Wrist-hinge trainer shown; grip trainer recommended verbally.
intervention.limits: No fitting instructions, exact grip change or practice dose supplied. Product is source example, not independently evaluated endorsement.

applicability: Verify clubface together with grip and wrist, not wrist extension alone.
Ensure actual problem is open face under suitable viewing conditions.
unknowns: Exact grip pattern, impact face and ball flight.
Aid effectiveness, fitting and student response.
cases.observed_result: Desired positions and product image only; no Brad after-aid swing or outcome.

selection.policy_origin: User one-focus preference; retain source sequencing and avoid simultaneous competing thoughts.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: suitable grip/top view and real start line, then aid-free response.

cases.title: Reassess trail-arm tension and shoulder alignment with face work
cases.coaching_finding: Coach selects softer trail arm and slightly closed shoulders.
cases.coach_reasoning: He attributes setup adjustments to anticipation of open face, making face work part of context.

intervention.cue: Soften trail arm and allow shoulders to close slightly.
intervention.sequence: Recheck with grip/wrist work rather than layering unrelated alignment fixes.

applicability: Actual setup supports this direction of change.
Do not prescribe closed shoulders to every golfer with an open face.
unknowns: True target line and measured shoulder alignment.
Whether face change alone removes setup adjustment.
cases.observed_result: No adjusted student setup or shot shown.

selection.policy_origin: User one-focus preference; retain source sequencing and avoid simultaneous competing thoughts.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: reassess alignment after face intervention and retain only necessary change.

measurement_register.value: Clubhead side of shaft, face-to-arm alignment and trail-arm/shoulder lines
limits: Camera-dependent illustrative judgments, not measured face or shoulder angles.
Shown retail image does not validate effectiveness or installation; price/reviews excluded.

cross_source_links.relation: Wrist extension depends on grip and face
cross_source_links.explanation: Cameron's wrist extension is accepted with strong grip and face matching arm. Brad's open face is selected for change. A cupped-wrist label cannot substitute for the grip/face relationship.
Moore's barrier tutorial excludes unresolved open face. Brad illustrates a face-first priority, but this source does not automatically establish that he needs a subsequent shallowing drill.

within_source_distinctions.relationship: Primary face priority with supporting setup reassessment. Avoid presenting aid, grip, wrist, arm and shoulder changes as five simultaneous thoughts.

annotation_opportunities: Label desired face line separately from actual clubface.
Attach grip context to wrist finding.
Mark retail image as illustration, not student demonstration.
excluded_material: Retail price and ratings as coaching evidence.

independent_validation.reason: Source extraction preserves evidence and conditions; a source match and response check are still needed for another golfer.
